subject: Pricing follow-up & discount request — startup program + committed use
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: discovery recap + pricing / discounts

Ethan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side.

Call summary:
- Use case: NovaFlow will use Redwood for inference powering LLM-powered code doc search + assistant (few-shot prompts, long context).
- Expected patterns: mix of short chat-style requests (~50-150 tokens per request) and bulk rerank/batch scoring jobs (larger sequences).
- Estimated volume (from your numbers): 300M–1B tokens/month in Q3 ramp, with a steady-state ask around 500M/mo. Please confirm if that matches what you have internally.

Pricing / cost qualification (what we discussed):
- Target unit economics you mentioned: target $/1M tokens in the mid-single digits to low double digits (roughly $5–$15 per 1M tokens) depending on committed volume.
- Budget range you mentioned on the call: ~$25k–$60k/month initially (scales with usage).

Discounts & programs we can discuss:
- Redwood Startup Program: up to 40% off list for qualifying startups in year 1 (requires YC/seed doc + cap table + startup form). Includes onboarding credits.
- Committed-use discounts: 12-month and 36-month commitments available. Typical bands: 12-mo: ~20–25% off list; 36-mo: ~30–35% off list. Deeper discounts for higher committed spend.
- Multi-year incentives: additional one-off incentives (e.g., implementation credits) available for multi-year/enterprise deals; finance approval required.

Attachments: I attached a simple pricing-model.xlsx with a few worked examples and a draft SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf).

Action items / asks from you:
1) Confirm the monthly token range you want us to model (e.g., 300M, 500M, 1B).
2) Confirm whether NovaFlow qualifies for the startup program (basic info, funding stage).
3) Decision timeline and legal contact for contract/PO routing.

Proposed next step: 30-min commercial call this week to walk through the worked examples and lock a preferred option. I’m available Wed/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks — we’ll prepare a short formal worked example once you confirm the volume band.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx, SOW_draft_v2.pdf

From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaflow.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap + pricing / discounts

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few clarifying Qs so we can align internally before the call:

1) How do you count tokens for batched rerank jobs vs chat? Do you bill the full input+output tokens per request?
2) For your worked examples, can you show a 1M-token baseline and then scale to 500M and 1B so our finance team can see line items?
3) We’re a funded seed-stage company (Seed, $6.5M) — would that qualify us for the startup program?
4) Can the startup program be stacked with a committed-use discount, or is it one or the other?

Budget context: we’re planning to commit roughly $30k–$45k/mo initially and may consider committing 12 months if the unit economics work out. Aim for target like $5–$10 per 1M if possible.

We can do Wed 10am PT for the commercial call. I’ll loop in our legal lead if you need contract-level conversations.

—
Ethan
Head of Platform, NovaFlow
ethan@novaflow.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaflow.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap + pricing / discounts

Ethan — great, thanks for the clarity. Wed 10am PT works. I answered your questions below and included a compact worked example (see pricing-model.xlsx for full table).

Token counting:
- We bill on total input + output tokens processed by the model. For batch rerank jobs we count the tokens processed per job (input tokens * candidates + output). We can show sample calculations in the workbook.

Stacking discounts:
- Startup program and committed-use discounts are mutually exclusive (you choose one). Reason: startup program is a promotional ramp for early-stage companies; committed-use is a contractual price concession tied to an ARR/commit. However, we can offer one-time implementation credits on top of committed deals for startups.

Worked examples (list price assumptions for this example):
- Base list price (reference): $18 per 1M tokens (model + infra + platform).
- Startup program (example): 40% off list in year 1 -> $10.80 per 1M tokens.
- Committed-use (examples): 12-mo commit at 25% -> $13.50 per 1M; 36‑mo commit at 35% -> $11.70 per 1M.

If NovaFlow’s target is ~$5–$10 per 1M, the startup program at 40% gets you into the low end of that band ($10.80). To reach ~$5/1M we’d need a deeper commercial incentive (large minimum spend/volume + multi-year pricing floor) — e.g., for 1B tokens/mo we could model into the mid-single digits, but that requires materially higher committed spend and term.

Example cost table (quick):
- 1M tokens/month: list $18 -> startup $10.80 -> 12-mo commit $13.50 -> 36-mo commit $11.70
- 500M tokens/month: list $9,000 -> startup $5,400 -> 12-mo commit $6,750 -> 36-mo commit $5,850
- 1B tokens/month: list $18,000 -> startup $10,800 -> 12-mo commit $13,500 -> 36-mo commit $11,700

Notes on implementation credits / incentives:
- For qualifying startups we commonly include $10k–$25k implementation credits in year 1 to offset engineering integration.
- Multi-year deals: we can negotiate an additional one-time incentive (credits or bill-credit) for 2+ year commitments; finance approval required.

Next steps for the call on Wed 10am PT:
- I’ll walk through the pricing-model workbook and show the 500M / 1B scenarios.
- Please have your legal/procurement ready for a high-level timeline; we’ll propose a formal term sheet after the call.

If you want me to model a target $5/1M scenario, confirm the exact expected token mix (chat vs rerank) and I’ll run the math.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx (updated), SOW_draft_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaFlow pricing posture / discount guidance

Marissa — looping in Laura for finance approval on the commercial posture. Quick recommendation from my side:

- Offer NovaFlow the choice of either: (A) Startup Program: 40% off list in year 1 + $15k implementation credit, or (B) Committed-use: 12-mo 25% off list OR 36‑mo 35% off list with standard billing cadence.
- We should NOT stack startup + committed. Instead, if they want committed pricing and are a qualifying startup, offer a one-time implementation credit on top of the committed discount (e.g., $10k).
- Set an internal expiration on the term sheet: 2 weeks from proposal date (to protect pricing).

Laura — can you confirm we can approve up to 40% for startup program for Seed-stage companies and authorize $15k onboarding credit? If not, please indicate the approved bands and I’ll reflect that on the call materials.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
ben@redwood.com
